verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs show it can create and send manual and automatic invoices, with built-in payment collection by card or ACH debit and paid-status tracking, in both the dashboard and the Accounts Receivable API. Branding of invoices (logos, custom styling) is never documented, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented invoice branding/customization, independent or hands-on corroboration of the invoicing and payment-collection flow.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can create and send branded invoices with built-in payment collection

citations.quote: Send manual and automatic invoices, accept flexible payment methods, and manage customer details right from your Mercury account.
Mercury's Accounts Receivable API lets you raise invoices from your own systems, collect by card or ACH debit, and know when each one is paid.
Invoices (List/Create/Get/Update/Cancel an invoice, Download invoice PDF)
Create up to 500 invoices/month on Mercury Plus, or unlimited invoices with Pro
